First time, or the GitHub key expired?

Set up the admin 设置管理后台

  1. On GitHub, open Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens → Generate new token.
  2. Repository access: Only select repositories → Jialan-Caps. Permissions → Repository permissions → Contents: Read and write. Nothing else.
  3. Paste the token below and choose an admin password (at least 12 characters). The token is stored only in encrypted form, locked by this password.
